# Distinct Subsequences II

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Platform | LeetCode |
| Language | python3 |
| URL | [https://leetcode.com/problems/distinct-subsequences-ii/](https://leetcode.com/problems/distinct-subsequences-ii/) |
| Submitted | 2026-09-07T11:29:48.000Z |


## Solution

```python
class Solution:
    def distinctSubseqII(self, s: str) -> int:
        MOD = 10**9 + 7
        end = [0] * 26
        for ch in s:
            i = ord(ch) - ord('a')
            total = sum(end) + 1
            end[i] = total % MOD
        return sum(end) % MOD
```
